meta.description: Community-maintained MLB injury database for National League stars

ronald-acuna-jr.name: Ronald Acuña Jr.

current_injury.type: Left hamstring strain (Grade 1, recurring); left fibula fracture (non-displaced, 2026) — now rehabbing at Triple-A
current_injury.mechanism: Strained hamstring running to first base; left fibula non-displaced fracture suffered Mar 3, 2026 in Spring Training
current_injury.severity: Moderate (hamstring Grade 1 recurring); fibula fracture resolved
current_injury.details: Left hamstring strain — 2nd occurrence this season. Placed on 10-day IL June 9, 2025. After extensive FCL rehab and cleared for all rehab gates, Acuña has progressed to Triple-A Gwinnett. He is scheduled to play for Gwinnett on July 18 and 19, 2026 and could return during the Braves' current homestand ending July 23. Fibula fracture (non-displaced) suffered March 3, 2026 in Spring Training; rehab started April 2026 and is now complete. No longer on 60-day IL.

pre_injury_stats.rbis: 22 (5 RBIs in rehab grand slam game)

rehab_timeline.rehab_gate_verdict: Acuña has cleared all rehab gates up to MLB activation. Playing at Triple-A Gwinnett on July 18-19. Expected to return for the Braves' homestand ending July 23. Any setback during live game action could still push return, but progress is ahead of schedule.

ronald-acuna-jr.notes: First injury-shortened season since 2023 ACL tear. Acuña has made remarkable progress: cleared all rehab gates, now playing at Triple-A Gwinnett. Expected return slipped from 'early-to-mid July' to 'July 22-23' — may return even sooner if Gwinnett games go well. Fibula fracture rehab is complete. Former teammate Ha-Seong Kim also in FCL rehab (finger inflammation), as is Andrew McCutchen. Home Run Derby availability improved with Triple-A progression. Community should monitor Braves beat reporters (Mark Bowman, Journal Sentinel) for activation updates. Acuña expressed patience: 'I think [I'm] going to be patient' about return timeline.

latest_update.event: Scheduled to play for Triple-A Gwinnett on July 18 and 19. Could return during Braves' homestand ending July 23. Fibula fracture rehab complete. All rehab gates cleared. Moving to MLB activation stage.

mookie-betts.name: Mookie Betts

current_injury.type: Stiff lower back (Jul 11) + Right wrist soreness (resolved Jul 2) + Post-viral fatigue
current_injury.mechanism: Lower back stiffness — not from specific incident. Wrist soreness resolved after treatment. Residual fatigue from viral illness (late July 2025 — ~25 lbs loss).
current_injury.details: Out 3+ games as of Jul 13 for back. Dave Roberts stated NOT expected on IL for back or wrist. Conservative day-to-day management. Residual fatigue from severe viral illness in late July 2025 that caused ~25 lbs weight loss (175 → 150 lbs). Also experienced the death of his stepfather. On a 7-game hitting streak (.355 avg over last 15 games).

rehab_timeline.viral_care: New medication prescribed; putting food down; full workout completed at Dodger Stadium; weight stabilizing at ~150 lbs

injury_history.return_status: Returned; 150 lbs, manager says 'turned a corner'

mookie-betts.notes: Most tumultuous recent stretch in recent memory for a star player: broken wrist, oblique strain (x2), severe illness, personal loss, back stiffness. All major injuries resolved. No IL expected for back or wrist. Conservative treatment; 7-game hitting streak (.355). Key timeline: Viral illness in late July 2025 after Tokyo trip; returned for home opener late March 2025. Oblique strain recurred April 2026 (10-day IL, activated after 2 OKC games). Back stiffness July 11, 2026 — day-to-day.

latest_update.event: Back stiffness day-to-day; out 3+ games. 7-game hitting streak (.355 avg over last 15). Manager Roberts: 'He's feeling a little better. Right now we're in a good spot — we're just managing day-to-day.'

freddie-freeman.name: Freddie Freeman

current_injury.type: No acute injury currently. Neck stinger (resolved Aug 2025). Chronic ankle (managed). Left rib/scar tissue (March 2025 — resolved).
current_injury.mechanism: Neck stinger from neck into right shoulder (Aug 2025). Chronic ankle from previous sprains. March 2025 left rib/scar tissue re-aggravated during BP for Tokyo opener.
current_injury.details: No acute injury currently preventing play. Neck stinger fully resolved. Chronic left ankle from June 2025 sprain managed with load management and treatment. March 2025 left rib/scar tissue issue was minor and resolved quickly. 75% certainty of playing through rib discomfort.

rehab_timeline.expected_return: N/A — Currently active and playing regularly
rehab_timeline.ankle_management: Ongoing with load management; occasional flare-ups monitored

freddie-freeman.notes: Chronic ankle issues (right debridement Dec 2024, left sprain Jun 2025) require ongoing monitoring. Walk-Off Grand Slam in 2024 WS legend despite injuries. Freeman is the most durable of the three tracked players. 2025 leading MLB in softball grounds, 30 SB in first 300 ABs, 25.9% walk rate. Lineup impact: Freeman moved to 2nd spot behind Ohtani after Betts' return. Dave Roberts: 'He feels a lot better. There's still some kind of lingering effects, but nothing compromising... I feel confident that he can get through it and won't have any setbacks.'

latest_update.event: Out vs. Reds Wednesday with neck stinger (neck into right shoulder). Returned to lineup Friday with no lingering effects. Surgery (right ankle debridement) performed Dec 2024. Currently playing with chronic ankle managed via load management.
